_about: Public risk lists matched against a product's category and country of origin (lookup ladder, country rung). Intentionally empty: rows must come from the real lists, never be typed from memory. Each row: { "id", "list", "good", "country", "risk": "child_labour" | "forced_labour", "source" }, where "good" uses the list's own name (e.g. "Garments", "Cotton") and "source" is a source id in this file's "sources". The US Department of Labor's List of Goods Produced by Child Labor or Forced Labor is published as a spreadsheet at https://www.dol.gov/agencies/ilab/reports/child-labor/list-of-goods (its server refuses scripted downloads, so download it in a browser).

sources.title: List of Goods Produced by Child Labor or Forced Labor (2024)
